function rayBox(o,d,x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1){let a=0,b=1e9,t1,t2,q;
if(Math.abs(d.x)<1e-9){if(o.x<x0||o.x>x1)return Infinity}else{t1=(x0-o.x)/d.x;t2=(x1-o.x)/d.x;if(t1>t2){q=t1;t1=t2;t2=q}if(t1>a)a=t1;if(t2<b)b=t2;if(a>b)return Infinity}
if(Math.abs(d.y)<1e-9){if(o.y<y0||o.y>y1)return Infinity}else{t1=(y0-o.y)/d.y;t2=(y1-o.y)/d.y;if(t1>t2){q=t1;t1=t2;t2=q}if(t1>a)a=t1;if(t2<b)b=t2;if(a>b)return Infinity}
if(Math.abs(d.z)<1e-9){if(o.z<z0||o.z>z1)return Infinity}else{t1=(z0-o.z)/d.z;t2=(z1-o.z)/d.z;if(t1>t2){q=t1;t1=t2;t2=q}if(t1>a)a=t1;if(t2<b)b=t2;if(a>b)return Infinity}
return a}
function segHit(x0,z0,x1,z1,b,e){let a=0,c=1;const dx=x1-x0,dz=z1-z0;
if(Math.abs(dx)<1e-9){if(x0<b.x0-e||x0>b.x1+e)return false}else{let p=(b.x0-e-x0)/dx,q=(b.x1+e-x0)/dx;if(p>q){const r=p;p=q;q=r}a=Math.max(a,p);c=Math.min(c,q);if(a>c)return false}
if(Math.abs(dz)<1e-9){if(z0<b.z0-e||z0>b.z1+e)return false}else{let p=(b.z0-e-z0)/dz,q=(b.z1+e-z0)/dz;if(p>q){const r=p;p=q;q=r}a=Math.max(a,p);c=Math.min(c,q);if(a>c)return false}return true}
function nearC(x0,x1,z0,z1){const found=[],q=++CQuery,cell=16;for(let gx=Math.floor(x0/cell);gx<=Math.floor(x1/cell);gx++)for(let gz=Math.floor(z0/cell);gz<=Math.floor(z1/cell);gz++){const bucket=CSpatial.get(gx+','+gz);if(!bucket)continue;for(const i of bucket){const b=C[i];if(b._cq!==q){b._cq=q;if(!b.destroyed)found.push(i)}}}found.sort((a,b)=>a-b);return found.map(i=>C[i])}

// Les collisions de DÉPLACEMENT restent des boîtes (AABB). Pour les BALLES et la ligne de vue des bots, chaque décor (carcasses de tank, arbres,
// rochers, barils, caisses, lampes...) utilise la vraie forme de ses pièces : boîtes orientées, cylindres/cônes, sphères. Les MAISONS gardent leurs boîtes.
// Le sol des tranchées est un relief (heightfield) : plus de mur invisible aux entrées, ni de « plafond » au-dessus des tranchées.
const _bm=new T.Matrix4(),_bb=new T.Box3(),_so={x:0,y:0,z:0},_sd={x:0,y:0,z:0};
function mkShape(m){const g=m.geometry;if(!g)return null;const p=g.parameters||{},ty=g.type;if(m.material&&m.material.transparent&&m.material.opacity<.5)return null;
let s=null;
if(ty==='BoxGeometry')s={k:0,hx:p.width/2,hy:p.height/2,hz:p.depth/2,cx:0,cy:0,cz:0};
else if(ty==='CylinderGeometry'||ty==='ConeGeometry'){const cone=ty==='ConeGeometry',r0=cone?p.radius:p.radiusBottom,r1=cone?0:p.radiusTop,f=Math.cos(PI/(p.radialSegments||8)),hh=p.height/2;s={k:1,A:(r0+r1)/2*f,B:(r1-r0)/2*f/hh,hh}}
else if(ty==='SphereGeometry')s={k:2,r:p.radius*.97};
else if(ty==='OctahedronGeometry')s={k:2,r:p.radius*.72};
else if(ty==='DodecahedronGeometry'||ty==='IcosahedronGeometry')s={k:2,r:p.radius*.92};
else if(ty==='PlaneGeometry'||ty==='CircleGeometry'||ty==='RingGeometry'||ty==='Points')return null;
else{if(!g.boundingBox)g.computeBoundingBox();const b=g.boundingBox;if(!b)return null;s={k:0,hx:(b.max.x-b.min.x)/2,hy:(b.max.y-b.min.y)/2,hz:(b.max.z-b.min.z)/2,cx:(b.max.x+b.min.x)/2,cy:(b.max.y+b.min.y)/2,cz:(b.max.z+b.min.z)/2}}
s.m=_bm.copy(m.matrixWorld).invert().elements.slice();return s}
// distance (en unités de d) à laquelle le rayon ENTRE dans la forme, Infinity sinon (rayon parti de l'intérieur = ignoré)
function shapeT(s,o,d){const e=s.m;
const ox=e[0]*o.x+e[4]*o.y+e[8]*o.z+e[12],oy=e[1]*o.x+e[5]*o.y+e[9]*o.z+e[13],oz=e[2]*o.x+e[6]*o.y+e[10]*o.z+e[14];
const dx=e[0]*d.x+e[4]*d.y+e[8]*d.z,dy=e[1]*d.x+e[5]*d.y+e[9]*d.z,dz=e[2]*d.x+e[6]*d.y+e[10]*d.z;
if(s.k===0){_so.x=ox;_so.y=oy;_so.z=oz;_sd.x=dx;_sd.y=dy;_sd.z=dz;const t=rayBox(_so,_sd,s.cx-s.hx,s.cy-s.hy,s.cz-s.hz,s.cx+s.hx,s.cy+s.hy,s.cz+s.hz);return t>1e-6?t:Infinity}
if(s.k===2){const a=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz,b=ox*dx+oy*dy+oz*dz,c=ox*ox+oy*oy+oz*oz-s.r*s.r;if(c<=0||a<1e-12)return Infinity;const disc=b*b-a*c;if(disc<0)return Infinity;const t=(-b-Math.sqrt(disc))/a;return t>1e-6?t:Infinity}
const hh=s.hh,A=s.A,B=s.B,k0=A+B*oy;if(Math.abs(oy)<=hh&&ox*ox+oz*oz<=k0*k0)return Infinity;
let best=Infinity;const k1=B*dy,a=dx*dx+dz*dz-k1*k1,b=ox*dx+oz*dz-k0*k1,c=ox*ox+oz*oz-k0*k0;
const side=t=>{if(t>1e-6&&t<best){const y=oy+dy*t;if(Math.abs(y)<=hh&&A+B*y>=0)best=t}};
if(Math.abs(a)>1e-12){const disc=b*b-a*c;if(disc>=0){const sq=Math.sqrt(disc);side((-b-sq)/a);side((-b+sq)/a)}}else if(Math.abs(b)>1e-12)side(-c/(2*b));
if(Math.abs(dy)>1e-12)for(const cy of[-hh,hh]){const t=(cy-oy)/dy;if(t>1e-6&&t<best){const x=ox+dx*t,z=oz+dz*t,r=A+B*cy;if(x*x+z*z<=r*r)best=t}}
return best}

// associe à chaque collider (non-maison) les vraies formes des objets de décor qu'il contient
function attachBulletShapes(){scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);const sz=new T.Vector3(),ct=new T.Vector3();

// relief : plan y=0, creusé par les tranchées (profondeur = depthAt). Un rayon parti d'un point sous le sol (unité qui remonte) est libre jusqu'à ressortir.
function rayTerrain(o,d,tmax){const x1=o.x+d.x*tmax,z1=o.z+d.z*tmax;let near=false;
for(const r of TR)if(segHit(o.x,o.z,x1,z1,r,0)){near=true;break}if(!near)for(const c of CRATERS)if(segHit(o.x,o.z,x1,z1,{x0:c.x-c.r,x1:c.x+c.r,z0:c.z-c.r,z1:c.z+c.r},0)){near=true;break}
if(!near){if(d.y<0&&o.y>0){const t=-o.y/d.y;return t<=tmax?t:Infinity}return Infinity}
const dl=Math.hypot(d.x,d.y,d.z)||1;let tEnd=tmax;if(d.y<0){const te=(-2.3-o.y)/d.y;if(te<tEnd)tEnd=Math.max(te,0)}
const step=.3/dl;let inside=o.y<depthAt(o.x,o.z)-.02,prev=0;
for(let t=0;;t+=step){const tt=Math.min(t,tEnd),y=o.y+d.y*tt,g=depthAt(o.x+d.x*tt,o.z+d.z*tt);
if(y<g){if(!inside){let lo=prev,hi=tt;for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2;if(o.y+d.y*mid<depthAt(o.x+d.x*mid,o.z+d.z*mid))hi=mid;else lo=mid}return hi<=tmax?hi:Infinity}}else inside=false;
prev=tt;if(tt>=tEnd)break}
return Infinity}

// premier obstacle sur le rayon o + d*t (t dans [0,tmax]) ; Infinity si rien
function rayWorld(o,d,tmax){let best=Infinity;const x1=o.x+d.x*tmax,z1=o.z+d.z*tmax;
for(const b of nearC(Math.min(o.x,x1)-.1,Math.max(o.x,x1)+.1,Math.min(o.z,z1)-.1,Math.max(o.z,z1)+.1)){if(b.trenchWall)continue;
if(b.sh){const q=b.bb;if(rayBox(o,d,q.x0,q.y0,q.z0,q.x1,q.y1,q.z1)>=best)continue;for(const s of b.sh){const t=shapeT(s,o,d);if(t<best)best=t}}
else{const t=rayBox(o,d,b.x0,b.y0||0,b.z0,b.x1,b.h,b.z1);if(t<best)best=t}}
const tg=rayTerrain(o,d,Math.min(best,tmax));if(tg<best)best=tg;
return best<=tmax?best:Infinity}

function botShoot(b,e,d,dt){const w=b.w,D=DIF[diff];if(b.cd>0||b.rl>0)return;if(!los(b,e)){b.vis=false;return}if(b.ammo<=0){b.rl=w.rel;b.ammo=w.mag;return}

// --- choix de l'objectif : d'abord A/B/C (ou E/D/C), puis les points attaqués / le front ---
function pickPt(b){if(t>70)b.init=[];
if(b.init&&b.init.length){const p=pts[b.init[0]];if(p.owner===b.team&&Math.abs(p.prog)>.98)b.init.shift();else{b.pt=p;b.ptT=4;b.lastPick=t;return}}
const T1=b.team,att=T1==1?'a1':'a2',order=pts.map(p=>p.i),front=(T1==1?order:order.slice().reverse()).find(i=>pts[i].owner!==T1);
let best=null,bs=-1e9;
for(const p of pts){const d=Math.hypot(p.x-b.pos.x,p.z-b.pos.z),mine=p.owner===T1,hot=mine&&t-p[att]<9;let s;
if(hot)s=120-d*.25;else if(!mine)s=70-d*.3+(p.i===front?30:0);else s=-40-d*.1;
let crowd=0;for(const u of U)if(u!==b&&!u.isP&&u.team===T1&&u.pt===p)crowd++;s-=crowd*16;if(b.pt===p)s+=14;s+=rnd(0,10);if(s>bs){bs=s;best=p}}
b.pt=best;b.ptT=rnd(2.5,4.5);b.lastPick=t}
function goto(b,x,z,spd,dt){
const trc=trenchAt(b.pos.x,b.pos.z);if(trc&&b.pos.y<-.4&&trenchAt(x,z)!==trc){const mx=(trc.x0+trc.x1)/2,mz=(trc.z0+trc.z1)/2,e1=trc.ax==='x'?[trc.x0-2,mz]:[mx,trc.z0-2],e2=trc.ax==='x'?[trc.x1+2,mz]:[mx,trc.z1+2];
const c1=Math.hypot(e1[0]-b.pos.x,e1[1]-b.pos.z)+Math.hypot(e1[0]-x,e1[1]-z),c2=Math.hypot(e2[0]-b.pos.x,e2[1]-b.pos.z)+Math.hypot(e2[0]-x,e2[1]-z),ee=c1<c2?e1:e2;x=ee[0];z=ee[1]}
const dx=x-b.pos.x,dz=z-b.pos.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);if(d<.7){b.moving=false;return}
if(b.navT<=0){b.navT=.3;const a=Math.atan2(dx,dz);let r=a;if(blocked(b.pos.x,b.pos.z,a,2.6)){r=null;const sg=b.nudA>0?1:-1;for(const o of [.6,-.6,1.2,-1.2,1.9,-1.9,2.6]){const q=a+o*sg;if(!blocked(b.pos.x,b.pos.z,q,2.6)){r=q;break}}if(r===null)r=a+rnd(-3,3)}b.mdir=r}
let a=b.mdir;if(t<b.nudge)a+=b.nudA;spd*=inWire(b.pos.x,b.pos.z)?.55:1;const nx=b.pos.x+Math.sin(a)*spd*dt,nz=b.pos.z+Math.cos(a)*spd*dt,step=groundH({x:nx,y:b.pos.y,z:nz});if(step>b.pos.y&&step-b.pos.y<=.45)b.pos.y=step;b.pos.x=nx;b.pos.z=nz;b.moving=true;b.yaw=turnTo(b.yaw,a,dt*6)}
// ===== MORT DES BOTS : animation réaliste (aïe → mains sur la blessure → 1 s immobile → chute → flaque de sang → disparition → réapparition) =====
const DEATH_REACT=.35,   // durée du sursaut + mains qui vont sur la blessure
      DEATH_HOLD=1,      // temps IMMOBILE (mains sur la blessure) avant de tomber
      DEATH_FALL=.9,     // durée de la chute
      DEATH_LIE=5,       // temps allongé dans la flaque avant de disparaître
      DEATH_TOTAL=DEATH_REACT+DEATH_HOLD+DEATH_FALL+DEATH_LIE;
const BLOOD_GEO=new T.CircleGeometry(1,18),DROP_GEO=new T.SphereGeometry(.045,5,4),DROP_MAT=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xa30a0a});
let BLD=[],POOLS=[];
const dSm=k=>{k=clamp(k,0,1);return k*k*(3-2*k)},dLerp=(a,b,k)=>a+(b-a)*k;
const _e1=new T.Vector3(),_e2=new T.Vector3(),_e3=new T.Vector3(),_eq=new T.Quaternion();

// cri de douleur synthétisé (WebAudio), volume/pan selon la distance au joueur
function ouchSnd(b){if(!AC)return;const dp=Math.hypot(b.pos.x-P.pos.x,b.pos.z-P.pos.z);if(dp>85)return;const vol=.9/(1+dp/12);
const rx=Math.cos(P.yaw)*(b.pos.x-P.pos.x)-Math.sin(P.yaw)*(b.pos.z-P.pos.z),pan=clamp(rx/Math.max(dp,1),-1,1),a=AC.currentTime,f=rnd(150,230);
tn(a,f*1.35,.1,'sawtooth',.22*vol,pan,0,f*1.1,.01);tn(a+.09,f*1.1,.5,'sawtooth',.2*vol,pan,0,f*.6,.03);tn(a+.09,f*2.2,.4,'triangle',.07*vol,pan,0,f*1.2,.03);nz(a,.38,'bandpass',950,2.5,.12*vol,pan)}

// cinématique inverse 2 segments : renvoie la position du coude
function armIK(S_,H_,pole,la,lb){const d=_e1.set(H_[0]-S_[0],H_[1]-S_[1],H_[2]-S_[2]),L=d.length();if(L<.001)return[S_[0],S_[1]-la,S_[2]];d.multiplyScalar(1/L);
const m=Math.min(L,la+lb-.01),x=(m*m+la*la-lb*lb)/(2*m),h=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,la*la-x*x)),p=_e2.set(pole[0],pole[1],pole[2]);p.addScaledVector(d,-p.dot(d));if(p.lengthSq()<1e-6)p.set(0,-1,0);p.normalize();
return[S_[0]+d.x*x+p.x*h,S_[1]+d.y*x+p.y*h,S_[2]+d.z*x+p.z*h]}
// k=0 : bras en position de tir (repos) ; k=1 : main sur Hw
function placeArm(arm,Hw,k){const H_=[dLerp(arm.H[0],Hw[0],k),dLerp(arm.H[1],Hw[1],k),dLerp(arm.H[2],Hw[2],k)],ik=armIK(arm.S,H_,[arm.side*.9,-.45,-.3],.4,.42),
E_=[dLerp(arm.E[0],ik[0],k),dLerp(arm.E[1],ik[1],k),dLerp(arm.E[2],ik[2],k)];setLimb(arm.up,arm.S,E_);setLimb(arm.fo,E_,H_);arm.hand.position.set(H_[0],H_[1]-UPY,H_[2])}

// où les mains se posent selon la zone touchée : [main gauche, main droite]
function woundHands(b,d){const z=d.zone;
if(z==='head')return[[-.17,1.68,.17],[.17,1.68,.17]];
if(z==='chest')return[[-.09,1.3,.23],[.13,1.22,.23]];
if(z==='stomach')return[[-.1,1.0,.25],[.1,.95,.25]];
if(z==='shoulder'){const hs=d.hs,r=[null,null];r[hs<0?0:1]=[hs*.43,.74,.05];r[hs<0?1:0]=[hs*.34,1.38,.1];return r}
const th=b.m.legs[d.hl<0?0:1].hip.rotation.x,v=_e3.set(d.hl*.16,.86-.25*Math.cos(th)-UPY,-.25*Math.sin(th)+.11).applyQuaternion(_eq.copy(b.m.up.quaternion).invert()),q=[v.x,v.y+UPY,v.z];
return[[q[0]-.03,q[1]+.05,q[2]],[q[0]+.03,q[1]-.05,q[2]]]}

function spawnBlood(p,dir,n,sp){if(!bloodOn)return;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const m=new T.Mesh(DROP_GEO,DROP_MAT);m.position.copy(p);m.scale.setScalar(rnd(.6,1.5));scene.add(m);BLD.push({m,v:new T.Vector3(dir.x*rnd(.5,2.4)*sp+rnd(-1,1),rnd(.8,2.8)*sp,dir.z*rnd(.5,2.4)*sp+rnd(-1,1)),life:1.6})}}
function deathFxUpdate(dt){for(let i=BLD.length-1;i>=0;i--){const d=BLD[i];d.life-=dt;d.v.y-=12*dt;d.m.position.addScaledVector(d.v,dt);if(d.life<=0||d.m.position.y<=depthAt(d.m.position.x,d.m.position.z)+.03){scene.remove(d.m);BLD.splice(i,1)}}}

function makePool(b,d){if(!bloodOn)return;const mat=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x6a0707,transparent:true,opacity:.92,depthWrite:false,polygonOffset:true,polygonOffsetFactor:-3,polygonOffsetUnits:-3}),g=new T.Group();
for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const c=new T.Mesh(BLOOD_GEO,mat),r=rnd(.45,.95);c.scale.set(r*rnd(.8,1.2),r*rnd(.8,1.2),1);c.rotation.x=-PI/2;c.position.set(rnd(-.3,.3),i*.002,rnd(-.3,.3));g.add(c)}
g.position.set(b.pos.x,depthAt(b.pos.x,b.pos.z)+.03,b.pos.z);g.scale.setScalar(.12);scene.add(g);const p={g,mat};POOLS.push(p);d.pool=p}
function removePool(p){if(!p)return;scene.remove(p.g);p.mat.dispose();const i=POOLS.indexOf(p);if(i>=0)POOLS.splice(i,1)}

// l'arme lâchée tombe au sol (gravité, rebond, finit couchée sur le côté)
function dropWeapon(b){const m=b.m,wg=m.weapon;m.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);const wp=new T.Vector3(),wq=new T.Quaternion(),ws=new T.Vector3();wg.matrixWorld.decompose(wp,wq,ws);
m.up.remove(wg);scene.add(wg);wg.rotation.order='YXZ';wg.position.copy(wp);wg.quaternion.copy(wq);wg.scale.copy(ws);const fx_=Math.sin(b.yaw),fz=Math.cos(b.yaw);
b.dth.wpn={g:wg,v:new T.Vector3(fx_*rnd(.3,1.2)+rnd(-.6,.6),rnd(.3,1.4),fz*rnd(.3,1.2)+rnd(-.6,.6)),sx:rnd(-5,5),sz:rnd(-4,4),bn:0,landed:false,lt:0}}
function updateDroppedWeapon(w,dt){const g=w.g;if(!w.landed){w.v.y-=17*dt;g.position.addScaledVector(w.v,dt);g.rotation.x+=w.sx*dt;g.rotation.z+=w.sz*dt;const gy=depthAt(g.position.x,g.position.z)+.1;
if(g.position.y<=gy){g.position.y=gy;if(w.bn<1&&w.v.y<-1.5){w.bn++;w.v.y*=-.28;w.v.x*=.5;w.v.z*=.5;w.sx*=.4;w.sz*=.4}else{w.landed=true;w.lt=0;g.rotation.x=((g.rotation.x+PI)%(2*PI)+2*PI)%(2*PI)-PI;g.rotation.z=((g.rotation.z+PI)%(2*PI)+2*PI)%(2*PI)-PI;w.tz=(Math.sin(g.rotation.z)>=0?1:-1)*PI/2}}}
else if(w.lt<.6){w.lt+=dt;const k=Math.min(1,dt*10);g.rotation.x+=(0-g.rotation.x)*k;g.rotation.z+=(w.tz-g.rotation.z)*k}}

function botDeathReset(u){const m=u.m,d=u.dth;if(d&&d.pool)removePool(d.pool);u.dth=null;const wg=m.weapon;if(wg.parent!==m.up){if(wg.parent)wg.parent.remove(wg);m.up.add(wg)}
wg.rotation.set(0,0,0);wg.scale.set(1,1,1);wg.position.set(-.06,1.2-UPY,.5);m.up.rotation.set(0,0,0);m.up.position.set(0,UPY,0);m.arms.forEach(a=>placeArm(a,a.H,0));
m.pose.children.forEach(o=>{if(o.geometry&&o.geometry.type==='OctahedronGeometry')o.visible=true})}

function startBotDeath(u,by,head){const m=u.m,hy=u.hitY,hs=Math.random()<.5?-1:1;let zone;
if(head||(hy!==undefined&&hy>1.55))zone='head';
else if(hy!==undefined){zone=hy>1?'chest':hy>.72?'stomach':'leg';if(zone==='chest'&&hy>1.3&&Math.random()<.4)zone='shoulder'}
else{const r=Math.random();zone=r<.4?'chest':r<.62?'stomach':r<.8?'shoulder':r<.92?'leg':'chest'}
// direction du tir (du tireur vers la victime) → sens de la chute
let dx,dz;if(by&&by!==u){dx=u.pos.x-by.pos.x;dz=u.pos.z-by.pos.z;const l=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;dx/=l;dz/=l}else{const a=rnd(0,PI*2);dx=Math.sin(a);dz=Math.cos(a)}
const sy=Math.sin(u.yaw),cyw=Math.cos(u.yaw),fl=dx*sy+dz*cyw,sd=dx*cyw-dz*sy;let axis,sgn;
if((zone==='stomach'||zone==='leg')&&Math.random()<.65){axis='x';sgn=1}
else if(Math.abs(fl)>=Math.abs(sd)){axis='x';sgn=fl>=0?1:-1}else{axis='z';sgn=sd>=0?-1:1}
const lx=axis==='z'?-sgn:0,lz=axis==='x'?sgn:0,fdx=cyw*lx+sy*lz,fdz=-sy*lx+cyw*lz; // direction de chute dans le monde
const kb={head:.25,chest:.35,stomach:1,leg:.85,shoulder:.2},fl_={head:.22,chest:.22,stomach:.7,leg:.6,shoulder:.12},jk={head:-.32,chest:-.26,stomach:.18,leg:.1,shoulder:-.12};
u.cr=false;m.g.scale.y=1;m.pose.rotation.set(0,0,0);
u.dth={zone,hs,hl:Math.random()<.5?-1:1,axis,sgn,fold:zone==='stomach'||zone==='leg',kb:kb[zone],flex:fl_[zone],jerk:jk[zone],tilt:zone==='shoulder'?-hs*.18:0,
lift:axis==='z'?.28:sgn<0?.36:.22,twist:rnd(-.5,.5),fdx,fdz,kx:dx,kz:dz,l0:[m.legs[0].hip.rotation.x,m.legs[0].knee.rotation.x,m.legs[1].hip.rotation.x,m.legs[1].knee.rotation.x],
dropped:false,wpn:null,pool:null,splat:false};
const wy={head:1.7,chest:1.3,stomach:1.0,leg:.55,shoulder:1.4}[zone],wound=new T.Vector3(u.pos.x+sy*.2+(zone==='shoulder'?cyw*hs*.3:0),u.pos.y+wy,u.pos.z+cyw*.2+(zone==='shoulder'?-sy*hs*.3:0));
spawnBlood(wound,{x:dx,z:dz},zone==='head'?14:10,1);
m.pose.children.forEach(o=>{if(o.geometry&&o.geometry.type==='OctahedronGeometry')o.visible=false});
ouchSnd(u)}

function botDeathUpdate(b,dt){const d=b.dth;if(!d){if(t>=b.resp)respawn(b,null,true);return}
const m=b.m,g=m.g,up=m.up,lg=m.legs,e=t-b.deadAt;
if(e>=DEATH_TOTAL||t>=b.resp){botDeathReset(b);g.visible=false;respawn(b,null,true);return}
const tF=DEATH_REACT+DEATH_HOLD,aR=dSm(e/DEATH_REACT),k=clamp((e-tF)/DEATH_FALL,0,1),fe=dSm(k);
// 1) l'arme est lâchée juste après l'impact
if(!d.dropped&&e>.07){d.dropped=true;dropWeapon(b)}if(d.wpn)updateDroppedWeapon(d.wpn,dt);
// 2) buste : sursaut à l'impact puis courbé sur la blessure (immobile pendant DEATH_HOLD)
const jerk=e<.2?d.jerk*Math.sin(PI*e/.2):0;let base=d.flex;if(k>0)base=d.fold?dLerp(d.flex,d.flex+.3,fe):dLerp(d.flex,-.1,fe);
up.rotation.x=dLerp(0,base,aR)+jerk;up.rotation.z=d.tilt*aR*(1-fe);
// 3) jambes : genoux qui plient (jambe touchée = levée), puis jambes qui s'affaissent
const fin=d.fold?[-1,1.7,-.7,1.3]:[-.15,.25,-.35,.5];
for(let i=0;i<2;i++){let hip=-.48*d.kb,kn=.9*d.kb;if(d.zone==='leg'&&((d.hl<0?0:1)===i)){hip=-.8;kn=1.4}
hip=dLerp(d.l0[i*2],hip,aR);kn=dLerp(d.l0[i*2+1],kn,aR);lg[i].hip.rotation.x=dLerp(hip,fin[i*2],fe);lg[i].knee.rotation.x=dLerp(kn,fin[i*2+1],fe)}
m.pose.position.y=-.17*d.kb*aR*(1-fe)-(d.fold?.22*Math.sin(PI*clamp(k*1.25,0,1)):0);
// 4) bras : mains sur la zone touchée, puis ils retombent mollement pendant la chute
const wh=woundHands(b,d);for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const arm=m.arms[i],Hs=[arm.side*.55,.7,-.05],Hw=wh[i];
if(k===0)placeArm(arm,Hw,aR);else{const q=dSm(k*1.2);placeArm(arm,[dLerp(Hw[0],Hs[0],q),dLerp(Hw[1],Hs[1],q),dLerp(Hw[2],Hs[2],q)],1)}}
// 5) chute du corps (bascule autour des pieds, rebond à l'impact, léger glissement)
let tip=1.5*k*k;if(e>tF+DEATH_FALL){const q=e-tF-DEATH_FALL;tip+=Math.exp(-q*8)*Math.sin(q*20)*.05}
g.rotation.set(0,b.yaw+d.twist*fe,0);if(d.axis==='x')g.rotation.x=d.sgn*tip;else g.rotation.z=d.sgn*tip;
const knock=.08*Math.sin(PI*Math.min(1,e/.3)),slide=.3*fe;
g.position.set(b.pos.x+d.kx*knock+d.fdx*slide,b.pos.y+d.lift*fe,b.pos.z+d.kz*knock+d.fdz*slide);
// 6) flaque de sang qui s'étend + éclaboussure à l'impact au sol
if(!d.pool&&e>DEATH_REACT+.3)makePool(b,d);
if(!d.splat&&k>=1){d.splat=true;const p=new T.Vector3(b.pos.x+d.fdx*.8,b.pos.y+.15,b.pos.z+d.fdz*.8);spawnBlood(p,{x:d.fdx*.5,z:d.fdz*.5},7,.45)}
if(d.pool){const gr=dSm((e-(DEATH_REACT+.3))/(tF+DEATH_FALL+3-(DEATH_REACT+.3))),c=dSm(k);d.pool.g.scale.setScalar(.12+1.05*gr);
d.pool.g.position.set(b.pos.x+d.fdx*.9*c,depthAt(b.pos.x,b.pos.z)+.03,b.pos.z+d.fdz*.9*c)}
// 7) dernière seconde : le corps s'enfonce et la flaque s'efface avant la réapparition
const fk=dSm((e-(DEATH_TOTAL-.9))/.9);if(fk>0){g.position.y-=.45*fk;if(d.pool)d.pool.mat.opacity=.92*(1-fk)}}


function botHasLowCover(b,e){for(const c of nearC(Math.min(b.pos.x,e.pos.x),Math.max(b.pos.x,e.pos.x),Math.min(b.pos.z,e.pos.z),Math.max(b.pos.z,e.pos.z))){if(c.hs||c.trenchWall||c.h<.65||c.h>1.25)continue;if(segHit(b.pos.x,b.pos.z,e.pos.x,e.pos.z,c,.15))return true}return false}
function botAtHouseWindow(b){for(const h of HOUSES)for(const w of h.windows)if(Math.abs(b.pos.y-w.y)<1.15&&Math.hypot(b.pos.x-w.insideX,b.pos.z-w.insideZ)<1.35)return true;return false}
function botWindowTarget(b,e){let best=null,bs=Infinity;for(const h of HOUSES){if(!h.windows.length)continue;const dHouse=Math.hypot(b.pos.x-h.cx,b.pos.z-h.cz);if(dHouse>52)continue;const inside=b.pos.x>h.x0+.6&&b.pos.x<h.x1-.6&&b.pos.z>h.z0+.6&&b.pos.z<h.z1-.6;for(const w of h.windows){if(Math.abs(e.pos.y-w.y)>1.3||Math.hypot(e.pos.x-w.x,e.pos.z-w.z)>60)continue;const proxy={pos:{x:w.x,y:w.y,z:w.z},cr:true};if(!losX(proxy,1.22,e,tgtH(e)))continue;const score=dHouse+Math.hypot(e.pos.x-w.x,e.pos.z-w.z)*.15;if(score<bs){bs=score;best={x:inside?w.insideX:h.doorX,z:inside?w.insideZ:h.insideDoorZ,house:h,window:w}}}}return best}
function botThrowNade(b,e){const dir=new T.Vector3(e.pos.x-b.pos.x,0,e.pos.z-b.pos.z).normalize(),p=new T.Vector3(b.pos.x+Math.sin(b.yaw)*.5,b.pos.y+1.25,b.pos.z+Math.cos(b.yaw)*.5),m=new T.Mesh(new T.SphereGeometry(.11,10,10),new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x3a4a2f}));m.castShadow=true;m.position.copy(p);scene.add(m);NG.push({m,p,v:dir.multiplyScalar(14).add(new T.Vector3(0,6,0)),f:2.4,by:b});b.nadeAt=t+120;b.cd=Math.max(b.cd,.7);sfx.swing()}
function botUpdate(b,dt){const D=DIF[diff];
if(b.dead){botDeathUpdate(b,dt);return}
if(b.drop){updateBotAirdrop(b,dt);return}
b.cd-=dt;if(b.rl>0)b.rl-=dt;b.navT-=dt;b.ptT-=dt;b.crT-=dt;if(t-b.lastHit>5&&b.hp<100)b.hp=Math.min(100,b.hp+2.5*dt);
b.groundT=(b.groundT||0)-dt;if(b.groundT<=0){b.groundT=.08;b.groundY=groundH(b.pos)}b.pos.y+=((b.groundY??depthAt(b.pos.x,b.pos.z))-b.pos.y)*Math.min(1,dt*12);
b.scanT-=dt;if(b.scanT<=0){b.scanT=.2+Math.random()*.15;let best=null,bestWindow=null,bd=3600;for(const e of U){if(e.team===b.team||e.dead)continue;const d=(e.pos.x-b.pos.x)**2+(e.pos.z-b.pos.z)**2;if(d>=bd)continue;const visible=los(b,e),sameHouse=HOUSES.some(h=>b.pos.x>=h.x0&&b.pos.x<=h.x1&&b.pos.z>=h.z0&&b.pos.z<=h.z1&&e.pos.x>=h.x0&&e.pos.x<=h.x1&&e.pos.z>=h.z0&&e.pos.z<=h.z1),window=visible?null:botWindowTarget(b,e);if(visible||sameHouse||window){best=e;bestWindow=window;bd=d}}
if(best){if(b.tgt!==best){b.tgt=best;b.react=D.react*rnd(.7,1.3)}b.windowPlan=bestWindow;b.seen=t;b.vis=los(b,best);b.visT=.1;if(best.isP&&b.vis)best.spot=t+1.5}else if(t-b.seen>2.5){b.tgt=null;b.windowPlan=null}}
if(t-b.sT>1){if(b.moving&&b.pos.distanceTo(b.sPos)<.6&&!b.tgt){b.nudge=t+.9;b.nudA=rnd(-2.5,2.5)}b.sPos.copy(b.pos);b.sT=t}
const e=b.tgt&&!b.tgt.dead?b.tgt:null;
if(e){const mdist=Math.hypot(e.pos.x-b.pos.x,e.pos.z-b.pos.z);if(mdist<2.15&&t>=(b.knifeAt||0)){b.knifeAt=t+.7;b.slashUntil=t+.3;b.cd=.7;hurt(e,60,b,false);sfx.swing()}else if(b.vis&&t>=(b.nadeAt||0)&&mdist>5&&mdist<16){const cluster=U.filter(x=>!x.dead&&x.team!==b.team&&Math.hypot(x.pos.x-e.pos.x,x.pos.z-e.pos.z)<5).length;if(cluster>=2||(b.hp<30&&mdist<11&&e.hp>45))botThrowNade(b,e)}b.sprinting=false;b.sprintT=0;b.visT=(b.visT||0)-dt;if(b.visT<=0){b.visT=.1;b.vis=los(b,e)}
// Ne s'accroupit que derrière un objet bas ou à une fenêtre ouverte.
b.windowHold=botAtHouseWindow(b);if(b.crT<=0){const cover=botHasLowCover(b,e);if(b.windowHold||cover&&(t-b.lastHit<2.5||Math.random()<.3)){b.cr=true;b.crT=rnd(1,2.2)}else{b.cr=false;b.crT=rnd(.5,1)}b.visT=0}
if(!b.vis){if(!(b.cr&&b.crT>0)){b.cr=false;const window=botWindowTarget(b,e);if(window){b.windowGoal=window;goto(b,window.x,window.z,b.spd,dt)}else goto(b,e.pos.x,e.pos.z,b.spd,dt)}b.react=D.react*.6}
else{const dx=e.pos.x-b.pos.x,dz=e.pos.z-b.pos.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;b.yaw=turnTo(b.yaw,Math.atan2(dx,dz),dt*D.turn);b.react-=dt;b.strT-=dt;if(b.strT<=0){b.strT=rnd(.6,1.8);b.strD=Math.random()<.5?-1:1}
const pref=Math.min(b.w.rng*.55,28);let f=d>pref+4?1:d<pref*.4?-1:0;if(b.hp<30)f=-1;if(b.windowHold)f=0;const nx=dx/d,nz=dz/d,side=b.windowHold?0:b.strD*.8,sp=b.spd*.8*(b.cr?.5:1)*(inWire(b.pos.x,b.pos.z)?.55:1);

else{b.cr=false;if(gameMode==='ffa'||gameMode==='tdm'){
if(!b.roam||t>=b.roamAt){b.roamX=rnd(-S*.72,S*.72);b.roamZ=rnd(-S*.72,S*.72);b.roamAt=t+rnd(6,12)}

}else{
if(!b.pt||b.ptT<=0)pickPt(b);let p=b.pt;
const inZone=Math.hypot(p.x-b.pos.x,p.z-b.pos.z)<R*.55,secured=p.owner===b.team&&Math.abs(p.prog)>.98;
if(inZone&&secured&&t-b.lastPick>1.5){pickPt(b);p=b.pt}
if(Math.hypot(p.x-b.pos.x,p.z-b.pos.z)>R*.55){const dist=Math.hypot(p.x-b.pos.x,p.z-b.pos.z);b.sprintT=Math.max(0,b.sprintT-dt);b.sprintCD=Math.max(0,b.sprintCD-dt);if(dist>45&&b.sprintT<=0&&b.sprintCD<=0){b.sprintT=rnd(1.2,1.8);b.sprintCD=rnd(6,9)}b.sprinting=dist>45&&b.sprintT>0;goto(b,p.x,p.z,b.spd*(b.sprinting?1.28:1),dt)}else{b.sprinting=false;b.sprintT=0;b.sprintCD=Math.max(b.sprintCD,2);b.hT-=dt;if(b.hT<=0){b.hT=rnd(1.5,3.5);const a=rnd(0,PI*2),r=rnd(0,R*.6);b.hx=p.x+Math.cos(a)*r;b.hz=p.z+Math.sin(a)*r}goto(b,b.hx,b.hz,b.spd*.5,dt)}}}
resolve(b.pos,.45);wireContact(b,dt);b.m.g.position.copy(b.pos);b.m.g.rotation.y=b.yaw;
const crouch=b.cr?1:0,phase=b.moving?Math.sin(t*(b.sprinting?13:9)+b.pos.x)*.58:0;b.m.pose.position.y+=(-.17*crouch-b.m.pose.position.y)*Math.min(1,dt*12);b.m.pose.rotation.x+=(crouch*.035-(b.sprinting&&b.moving?.06:0)-b.m.pose.rotation.x)*Math.min(1,dt*10);
b.m.legs[0].hip.rotation.x=-.48*crouch+phase;b.m.legs[1].hip.rotation.x=-.38*crouch-phase;
b.m.legs[0].knee.rotation.x=.9*crouch+Math.max(0,-phase)*.38;b.m.legs[1].knee.rotation.x=.82*crouch+Math.max(0,phase)*.38;b.moving=false}
